# Verde Talent

> Verde Talent is a US job board dedicated to the clean energy industry: solar,
> wind, battery storage, grid and utilities, EV infrastructure, hydrogen, energy
> policy and sustainability. Open roles are updated daily, so listings are
> current and link straight to the employer's application. Searching and
> applying are free and need no account; a free
> candidate profile is optional and adds weekly job-match emails. Employers can
> post a role from $100. Salary ranges are shown wherever an employer discloses
> them, and the site publishes its own salary benchmarks and hiring data.
> Contact: contact@verdetalent.com

## Find jobs
- [Job search](https://verdetalent.com/jobs.html): every open role, filterable by sector, location, salary, seniority, work style and skills. Also covers remote and international roles.
- [Browse by location and role](https://verdetalent.com/browse.html): hub pages for each sector, job function and state - for example solar jobs in Texas, or wind technician jobs nationally.
- [Companies hiring](https://verdetalent.com/companies.html): employers currently hiring in clean energy, with their open role counts.

## Pay and career research
- [Salary benchmarks](https://verdetalent.com/salaries.html): what clean energy roles pay, by role and state, drawn from posted salary ranges.
- [Career profiles](https://verdetalent.com/careers.html): what each role does, the skills asked for, entry-level share, where the jobs are and which employers hire for it.
- [Training and certifications](https://verdetalent.com/professional-development.html): certification paths and training providers by sector (NABCEP, NERC, EVITP, LEED and others).
- [Hiring data and market intelligence](https://verdetalent.com/intelligence.html): which sectors and roles are hiring, supply and demand by role, and salary benchmarks.

## News
- [Clean energy news](https://verdetalent.com/news.html): weekly industry and hiring news, with a free email briefing.
- [News feed (RSS)](https://verdetalent.com/feed.xml)

## For employers
- [Post a job](https://verdetalent.com/post-job.html): $100 for a 30-day posting; 5- and 10-post packs work out at $85-$90 each.
- [Hiring and recruiting data](https://verdetalent.com/hire.html): hiring volumes, posted salary benchmarks and the employers competing for the same talent.

## For candidates
- [Create a free profile](https://verdetalent.com/create-profile.html): optional; adds weekly job-match emails and lets employers find you.
- [Resume Vault](https://verdetalent.com/resume-vault.html)

## About
- [About Verde Talent](https://verdetalent.com/about.html): what the site is, who runs it, and how the data is gathered.
- [All pages (sitemap)](https://verdetalent.com/sitemap.xml)
